# One person owns every carrier contract

## Decision Question

Who signs, renews, and ends a contract with a carrier?

## Decision Outcome

Priya Sandhu owns every carrier contract. Nobody else commits the bakery to a rate or a term.

## Alternatives Considered

- Leaving each contract with whoever booked the first job, which is how two rate cards ended up live at once.

## Approved By

The owners, at the 2026-05-14 carrier review.
